name: Weather Table
description: p.96-97. Make a weather check every 6-hour interval: roll 2D and apply the Temperature Dice Modification and the Effect on Next Weather Check DM of the previous result. Temperature Dice Modification (Above Average (Tropical) / Average (Temperate) / Below Average (Polar) / Ice World / Hot World): Frozen -1 / -2 / -4 / -6 / X; Cold -0 / -1 / -2 / -4 / X; Temperate +1 / +0 / -1 / -2 / +2; Hot +2 / +1 / -0 / X / +4; Boiling +4 / +2 / +1 / X / +6. Each atmosphere has a specific range for weather; reroll results outside it: Frozen 1-5; Cold 2-8; Temperate 1-13; Hot 9-13; Boiling 13+. Roll 1D for the weather type. Survival DM applies to survival tasks in the next six hours, in addition to terrain DM. Harm from exposure applies without adequate shelter, split evenly between all three physical characteristics.

name: Planetside Encounter Type Table
description: p.100. If an encounter occurs (roll 1D plus the Encounter Chance & Type DM; 6+ is an encounter), roll 2D and apply the same DM. Encounter Chance & Type DM by location: Forest/Jungle +3 DM; Wetland +2 DM; Shrubland/Mountain +1 DM; Open Country +0 DM; Aquatic -1 DM; Polar/Desert -2 DM; Vacuum -3 DM. Also apply any weather DM.

name: Planetside NPC Encounter (Animal)
description: p.100. Roll 2D when a planetside encounter is an NPC Encounter. Animals: use the Animal generator based on terrain (p.110); results 3-5 are a single animal of any type, and x2, x3, or x4 multiplies the result of the Appearing column on the Animal Table. NPC: use the NPC generator. Mixed: generate two or more types of animals, NPCs, or both.

name: Planetside Location Encounters Table
description: p.100-101. Roll D66 (D36 in Aquatic and Polar/Desert terrain; D16 in Vacuum). The UWC Population Code is the DM to the tens place. Occupied locations: results 11-26 have an Average (8+) chance of being in use, modified by terrain DM. Labor sites: results 41-46 have an average (8+) chance of being in use; 2 or less means abandoned and 3-7 means a skeleton crew or a single worker remains; they do not roll on the Habitat Condition table. For results 41-62, roll on the Habitat Condition tables. Outposts: roll 1D (see Outpost Type). Settlements: results 61-66 have the same Law Level as the planet. Found vehicles and ships: roll 1D for non-crashed ships or vehicles (see Found Vehicle or Ship Condition).

results.text: Shelter made of recycled and scavenged material

name: Outpost Type (Planetside Location)

name: Found Vehicle or Ship Condition
description: p.101. Roll 1D for non-crashed ships or vehicles found on the Planetside Location Encounters Table to determine their condition.

name: Habitat Condition (Occupied)
description: p.101. If a result of 41-62 on the Planetside Location Encounters Table is rolled, roll 2D in each column of the Habitat Condition table and apply the Encounter Chance & Type DM (Forest/Jungle +3, Wetland +2, Shrubland/Mountain +1, Open Country +0, Aquatic -1, Polar/Desert -2, Vacuum -3). Abandoned: this location appears to be not in use or operational. In use: this location is operational and clearly indicates who owns and operates the location. Occupied: this location is operational, but it is unclear who owns and operates the location and what the habitat's function is. BOOK: the Occupied column of the book stops after "Abandoned and", "Abandoned but", "Occupied but" and "Occupied and"; this table completes each one with the word of the Condition column on the same row.

name: Settlement Encounter Table
description: The Toolkit's settlement encounter applies the population and law level DMs to the tens die for you. To roll this table by hand, add DM x10 to the result. p.102-103. Every six hours (or every 1D hours) spent exploring a settlement, roll D66 and apply the total DM to the tens place. Population DM: 3 or less -3; 4-5 -2; 6-7 -1; 8-9 +0; 10(A)+ +1. Law Level DM: 0 0; 1-3 +1; 4-5 +2; 6-8 +3; 9+ +4. Settlement condition by result: 01 - 06 Abandoned or neglected; 11 - 16 Seedy; 21 - 26 Rundown; 31 - 36 Out of date; 41 - 46 Maintained; 51 - 56 Burgeoning; 61 - 66 Esteemed; 71 - 76 Decline; 81 - 86 Dystopian; 91 - 96 Oppressive. Random NPCs: use the Random NPC Table (p.58) with the range stated in the result, and the NPC demeanour table (p.56) with SOC DM applied. Legal Encounters: once per day, including on entry, roll 2D; if the roll is under the local law level the encounter is a legal encounter.

name: Planetside Environment Encounters
description: p.104. Roll D66. Range 11-16 can be used for Atmosphere 0. Range 21-26 can be used for Atmospheres 1-3. Range 11-66 can be used for Atmospheres 4-9. Atmospheres A-F use the Unique Atmosphere Planetside Environment tables for 11-16. Avoiding: it takes 6 hours to travel around an encounter on foot, while dangerous weather changes take 1D days to pass by. *All roadways will continue if followed until they lead to a Planetside Location Encounter.
